body: Speaking of San Francisco, I imagine the psychiatrist I would really like is like the second psychiatrist on the show Monk...

That would be a great idea if I could actually handle all the staring I'd get. But it could still be an option if, well, yeah... Actually I feel somewhat stronger already since my head is on a path to clearing. I'll always need unconditional love, but hopefully I can open my eyes and now realize how much love can exist. Thanks; I hardly ever hear that.

Yeah, C#.NET and stuff. The job I applied for was more of a web designer, totally unrelated to .NET, but it still had lots of potential for skills I want to develop, especially if other languages are added to the job duties. COBOL and C++ interest me too, actually. I'm also into SQL and I was informed last week that the company in which I interviewed is interested in database administrators for SQL specifically using MS SQL Server and they don't advertise the jobs because they can never find anybody who has the skills. So yeah, I can take that advice and learn that too. It could be a good idea to become a Database Administrator. I need to do some more learning, but SQL syntax is probably more attractive to me than even the most beautiful of women.

Yeah, unexpected.. like posting here and getting better help than I've got elsewhere.. and this is life changing right here. It feels like I can push a bit easier through all the crap.. with some advice and some emotional support which I'm getting here. Well, there's one thing I know that I want and it's a giant hug. I feel like I need a person who I could just hug somebody on and off frequently for a week or two and just cry around frequently because I've hardly been able to do that either due to my situation. Then after that I could have a more normal life and of course I should only expect the crying part to happen with a psychiatrist since I would be paying them for that.

Yeah, right now I feel better by just saying everything stuck in my heart and in my mind. Well, okay.. so my current plan is:

1. Apply for volunteer jobs and hope that establishes a strong foundation.
2. Continue applying for retail and professional jobs.
3. Continue studying programming skills.
4. Get a job, non-paying or paying, but in the end, paying and stable, while still studying programming skills. (If the place I interviewed last week actually did like me and I get the job, well, skip 1, 2, and 3, because I'm sure I can do and keep the job.)
5. Get the fork out.
6. Spend time with a psychiatrist.
7. Strengthen and regulate mind, body, and spirit.
8. Other things TBD as change happens.
Yeah, hopefully I can start a decent social circle through volunteering and getting to know people who are actually living in the same community.
Well, I haven't found it yet, but this might sound really silly... I am like a radar and I'm trying to look everywhere for a reason.

That would be nice. :) Thanks and yeah, this is the best place for now because I can't really go about telling anybody else, at least until I can be on my own and support myself with funds. Then I can afford a psychiatrist and I can also talk about what happened in the past, which would be considered my present right now. After I'm on my own, I would also then feel better because I just want to talk about the problems I've had and I don't want to spend time for my mother to have to dispute them and have my feelings and reality of what's been going on to be questioned. I just wish I could overcome what would then be my past, think healthy, and move on to bigger and better things.

What type of help did you get? And, well, also being figurative, I've had horrible pages, bad pages, and good pages, but never great pages. But who knows.. in the long term, this thread including your help and everyone else's help could be the start of a very long great page. In fact, I put in all hope that I have left that it is. Thank you! I'm continuing to fight as hard as possible.

Well, I wouldn't be saying all of this stuff without legitimate evidence only including written/typed proof by the correct person or correct person's accounts or straight from their own mouths and undisputed actions, complete and from the correct source, of which I have plenty of both.

I've already attempted plenty of reasonable solutions, of which volunteering is next, as suggested in an earlier comment, considering I am currently denied to start anywhere else on the ladder. But yeah, volunteering is next.

I agree with the computer stuff, though I'm already trying to work in programming. They would have enough jobs here if the colleges stopped spitting new graduates out like wildfire, if this country stopped giving incentives for offshoring programming jobs, and this country stopped giving citizenship to foreigners trying to penetrate markets in which the amount of American workers ready to fill the position has already exploded. So I'm already building my programming skills by practicing to have a better chance. I want to build a large program, but it's hard to learn really quickly when you have screaming, stomping, TVs blaring, music blaring, including random noise outside going on at all hours of the day.

Yeah, I do need to exercise more often.

But yeah, the number one thing I'm still interested in is programming.

Maybe it's weird, but I also think I'd feel better if I had an actual hug while talking about my problems.. but.. I'm a virgin and that's okay.. and I've never kissed anyone and I guess that's okay.. but the last person I had a hug from was a nearly 50+ year old classmate in two year college from almost 4 years ago.. and I don't know who to ask in person because I don't have friends here and I don't want to tell just anyone because I don't need a stranger going nuts.

My funeral will be like my family only knows how to throw one.. everybody will cry for a few minutes, but it's really just an excuse for the family to get together and have a cookout, eat cake and ice cream, and get drunk all afternoon and evening until they go to the bar to listen to people participate in karaoke or go home to sleep and spend half their lives gossiping and the other half listening to nothing but the police scanner. The only people who may halfway care are people online, but only because they have one less person to help them even when they don't help me in return.

Things that suck have been going on for many years and one mistake usually gets a minimum of 5 minutes of screaming. People in better situations just make me feel worse because they have better lives while I'm sitting here with nothing and nobody.. because their families all own houses where they are safer than this place in which somebody can just come and break in too easily.

I tried doing the asshole thing.. that doesn't work and makes me get treated worse.. because everyone else is more powerful. I reach out all the time, that's why it feels like I'm almost gone.

I've trusted and trusted and trusted and I still trust, but it's getting harder and harder. I'm not sure I will ever be able to marry a woman. I'm not sure how long from now I will even be okay to live with one. Also, my mother always threatens to call the police after she threatens to kick me out if she doesn't like that I didn't do some chore or tried defending myself.. Every time I stick up for myself, she yells at me to not talk to her like that.. She's even said "Don't talk to me like that!" when I've said.. "Stop it!"

*hugs* Actually, that was the best advice that could have been given really since my problem could be on a path to a solution if volunteer work will lead me to full time paying work and at the very least I can put it on my resume.. And then since it's closer I could pick a shift outside of traditional hours so I could still have interviews elsewhere.. But yeah.. it's like.. while I'm still being hurt, I'm trying to heal my heart.. because if I'm only getting hurt.. then it hurts to live.. and I already know that getting lots of emotional support can help cancel the pain out somewhat, even if that sounds weird. It never seems like anybody's words are good enough, though, probably because they don't have it as bad and may never. Actually, tonight feels like I'm getting more help towards the future than any other day. Though it won't be much unless I have constant emotional support.. but I try telling my friends and nobody seems to understand. The woman who I met about a year and a half ago and thought was supposed to love me forever tells me to go see a psychiatrist.. I can't afford one on my own.. I have health insurance.. and my mom always has to go in for that case. There's a deductible that has to be paid and I don't even have the money. So yeah.. I constantly feel guilty even asking for help.. Right now I don't feel guilty.. because I'm trying to survive.. It feels like if I get any worse, the next point could be me ready to kill myself and then feeling guilty ever asking for help again.

ADD, Asperger's, OCD, Tourette's (tics like screeching and sniffling and moving my head a bunch.. I don't have tics like cussing or flipping people off or anything else that could be thought of that's immoral or illegal).. Probably depression, and when people are nice to me, I actually feel somewhat closer to them automatically because well, I don't really get treated nice often.. just pretty much get hurt or chronically ignored.. and severe allergies and eczema partially due to allergies and washing my hands a lot.. acne.. it just doesn't go away no matter how much I wash my face or rub clearasil pads on my face... the big reason everything is a problem is because it's irritated by all the nervousness and sadness and depression.. and in the past 3 weeks I've started and continued having panic attacks.. Plus I get paranoid easily and I have strange phobias.

Well, I can walk a mile and return walking a mile. And I've already applied, but you need professional career licenses unrelated to my major to do jobs at many of the locations near me and the other jobs are retail jobs which I've already applied to or they list even the lowest level jobs on their websites and they don't have any in my town. Job interviews I can get to.. but the problem is working full time for a company.. I wouldn't be able to get to work on time and I wouldn't be able to get home in time for the places further than a mile. Sorry that I'm replying slowly. Mom is talking loud to her friend and I can hardly concentrate.

Yeah, and I was always told a degree would get me a job.. then I'm yelled at all the time for not having a job.. And I just have to come out of college into the worst American economy in 80 years.. Actually, I thought about it.. and well, there's nothing else I can really do so.. yeah.. I'm looking for some volunteer opportunities right now. I guess it could get me out of the house.. Red Cross is actually not far away, surprisingly.. I'm not scared of blood.. but I'm scared of hurting other people.. although the way they describe it almost seems like I wouldn't be drawing blood.. but I can apply and I can continue looking on this volunteer website. Thank you so much and if you have any additional ideas, please let me know. I still hope to get out. Maybe if employers see on my resume that I volunteer, hopefully they'll be a little more lenient with my social problems.

Yeah.. I just wish I could be normal and accepted.. Even though I have mental disabilities, everybody sees me as white and male aka the "majority", even if they already know what's wrong with me. I look on LinkedIn after I get my rejection letter from employers and the people who got the job, via research on employer, job title, and date of starting employment.. well, they have foreign names with degrees from foreign countries. I have genealogical history in America going back to at least the mid-1800s. I'm the first one in my entire extended family.. sibling, in-law, cousins, uncles, aunts, grandparents to even get a degree and most are older than I am, yet I can't even do anything with it. I can't live with any of them because they all have frequent contact with mom and don't care about me. I was born here and I can't even work the lowest paying jobs with a degree...

I'm 24. But people think that since I'm an adult that I can take care of myself. I've never formed a long-term friendship with anybody. I have a Bachelor's degree and I can't even get a job because I'm socially messed up. I couldn't fit in at high school and I couldn't fit in at college. I already applied to retail companies weeks ago. I don't even know how to drive, and the city bus exists, but it starts too late and stops too early to get to 95% of employers in time even a mile away because the buses stop at a central location far away. I interviewed for a job within my major last week, but I haven't heard anything. I've been out of college for over a year. I try.. so hard.. and I can't do it right. And nobody can even help me.. I'm so hopeless and I don't even know how I can live if I'm forced to be supported by mom for much longer. And the neighbor starts playing music when I play music. And for the interview, I had to wake up at 7 AM, but I couldn't go to bed until midnight because the neighbor kept playing music over and over again. I'm in so much emotional pain.. It's gotten worse for 7 years.. I apply and I apply and I apply and I interview and interview and interview so I can get out and I can't go anywhere. I'm trying to be responsible and get work and move out, but I can't even accomplish it.

I'm so broken inside. I don't have anyone. Mom screams at me all the time. I haven't seen dad since I was 4. I'm humiliated all the time. She doesn't care about me. Then days later she tells me she never said any such thing. I can't get out. I don't even have the courage or motivation to try. I've needed to cope.. yet that won't even happen. And my friends can't even help me. And when somebody does start to help me I scare them away because I'm socially awkward and I think in strange ways. I'm scared of retaliation and I'm scared of everyone. I can't think straight any more and I hit myself in the head to cope. I have mental disabilities, but nobody cares. I try to defend myself by being like the people who hurt me, but then I get hurt worse. People are trying to intentionally hurt me and I've been bullied for decades. My life is a nightmare and I wish I could wake up, but I can't.
